about: Swordsman is a realistic sword-fighting game with challenging opponents and epic boss fights. Experience real combat that requires strategy against armored, physically simulated enemies that can parry, riposte, step, and dodge in this action-packed, award-winning game!

Remember, approach every fight like a real duel. Parry enemies and strike them when they're weak! Physically simulated weapons and realistic armor physics will challenge you in this visceral combat experience.
See Knights, Vikings, Mongols, Samurai, Pirates, epic battles on ships in the Caribbean, a Kraken, and so much more.

Visit the Blacksmith to purchase weapons or take down powerful bosses to unlock their unique weapons and special abilities as you gear up for increasingly difficult fights on your quest to find the Jötunn.

But wait... weapons alone will not be enough to defeat the Jötunn. Visit the Skill Master to upgrade your stats and skills and the Armorer to equip yourself with better armor. Be strategic and build your ideal character to suit your unique playstyle.
・Advanced combat mechanics with intelligent opponents that can engage in real sword-play
・Dismemberment, armor physics, hand-to-hand combat and advanced weapon handling
・Factions, including: Knights, Vikings, Mongols, Samurai, Pirates and eight different bosses
・Horde: a zombie survival mode (try the Hard version for maximum intensity)
summary: Swordsman is a realistic sword-fighting game with challenging opponents and epic boss fights.
